description: This file defines the HttpSmartTurnAnalyzer class, which performs remote ML inference for end-of-turn detection via HTTP requests. It handles serialization of audio data, communicates with an external HTTP endpoint, processes responses, and manages errors.

classes.name: HttpSmartTurnAnalyzer
classes.description: A smart turn analyzer that sends audio data to a remote HTTP endpoint for ML-based end-of-turn detection. It manages serialization, HTTP communication, error handling, and prediction requests.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, url: str, aiohttp_session: aiohttp.ClientSession, headers: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the HttpSmartTurnAnalyzer with the endpoint URL, HTTP session, optional headers, and additional parameters.

methods.name: bytes _serialize_array(self, audio_array: np.ndarray)
methods.description: Serializes a NumPy audio array to bytes for HTTP transmission using `np.save` into a bytes buffer.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _send_raw_request(self, data_bytes: bytes)
methods.description: Sends serialized audio data to the remote HTTP endpoint asynchronously, processes the response, and handles errors and timeouts.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _predict_endpoint(self, audio_array: np.ndarray)
methods.description: Performs end-of-turn prediction by serializing the audio array, calling the async request in a thread-safe manner, handling exceptions, and returning default prediction data on failure.
